name: economy_nerfs
objective: Sources: Blizzard Nov 10 hotfixes, Blizzard forums, ConquestCapped, Kami Labs.
pages: Enchanting wands sell to vendors for just 1 copper. Players report the AH is flooded too.
Nov 10: vendors pay less for some Leatherworking, Tailoring and Blacksmithing armor. Blizzard: they were meant to be crafted once.
Vendor price cut to 1 silver 25 copper (was 5 silver). Crafting them to sell now loses gold.
The Frost slows behind giant AoE pulls were weakened, so classic mage farming is much less profitable (per Kami Labs).
A Black Market vendor, Mister Graphed in the Riverglades, sells it at a fixed price, capping what it's worth.
Most quests level 48 and up now give gold. Leather, cloth and potions sell steadily (ConquestCapped).
Before crafting to vendor, compare the sell price with what the materials cost.
